# HaikaiTech Solutions

> HaikaiTech Solutions is a registered software engineering studio in Penang, Malaysia (SSM: 202603149868, CA0422517-K). We build business websites, custom web apps, dashboards, and interactive systems for clients across Malaysia — most of our clients are based in Kuala Lumpur — and worldwide. From one-time "Website Siap" packages to fully managed monthly plans and quotation-based custom software.

## Services

- [Services & Pricing](https://haikaitech.my/services/): Business websites (one-time from RM1,500 or RM199/month managed), company profile design, custom software, add-ons, and maintenance pricing.
- [Business Toolkit](https://haikaitech.my/toolkit/): Free tools for Malaysian SMEs — invoice generator, quotation builder, receipt maker, purchase order, and payroll calculator.

## Portfolio

- [AVS Bina](https://haikaitech.my/projects/avsbina/): Construction company website built with Astro and React.
- [Adyumrah Hajj & Umrah](https://haikaitech.my/projects/adyumrah/): Hajj & Umrah travel booking platform with admin dashboard.
- [Hawker Rewards](https://haikaitech.my/projects/hawkerrewards/): Loyalty rewards app for hawker stalls.
- [Clarity Learn Centre](https://haikaitech.my/projects/clarity-learncentre/): Learning centre website with course information.
- [Fuzzfloor](https://haikaitech.my/projects/fuzzfloor/): Premium editorial presentation site.
- [Murtajiz](https://haikaitech.my/projects/murtajiz/): Project case study.

## Blog

- [How Much Does a Business Website Cost in Malaysia? (2026 Guide)](https://haikaitech.my/blog/how-much-does-a-business-website-cost-in-malaysia/): Transparent website pricing breakdown — one-time from RM1,500, managed RM199/month, company profiles RM800–1,200, add-ons, and hidden costs.
- [Website Siap: A Complete Malaysian SME Website for RM1,500](https://haikaitech.my/blog/website-siap-malaysian-sme-website/): What the one-time Website Siap package includes, plus the RM350/year renewal.
- [The RM199/Month Managed Website Plan — What You Get](https://haikaitech.my/blog/rm199-managed-website-plan-malaysia/): Fully managed website with hosting, SSL, security, backups, maintenance, and support.
- [How to Choose a Web Developer for Your KL Business (Malaysia-Wide)](https://haikaitech.my/blog/how-to-choose-a-web-developer-in-kuala-lumpur/): Hiring checklist — pricing, ownership, maintenance, SEO, and why location matters less.
- [Custom Software in Malaysia: Web Apps, Dashboards, .NET, and Unity](https://haikaitech.my/blog/custom-software-malaysia-web-apps-and-dashboards/): When a website isn't enough, and how quotation-based pricing works.
- [How Much Does a Company Profile Website Cost in Malaysia?](https://haikaitech.my/blog/company-profile-website-cost-malaysia/): Company profile pricing — PDF profiles RM800–1,200, profile websites from RM1,500, and bundle options.
- [How Much Does Website Maintenance Cost in Malaysia?](https://haikaitech.my/blog/website-maintenance-cost-malaysia/): Maintenance pricing — small updates RM50–100, section changes RM100–200, new pages RM150–250, or managed at RM199/month.
